name: mk.najdikola/cars
title: Najdikola: used cars in North Macedonia
description: Search, compare and price used-car listings in North Macedonia (Najdikola).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search used-car listings. Every filter is optional and they combine; ranges are inclusive (price_from=price_to=12000 finds €12,000 cars). Names (brand, model, location, body_types, dealer) accept any case, Cyrillic or Latin, missing accents and common aliases (VW, Mercedes, sedan, Скопје); an unknown name is an error that lists the closest valid names. A brand alone also finds its listings whose model is "Other"; an "(All)" model includes every variant. Returns listings with listing_id, title, najdikola_url, price_eur (null = price on request), year, mileage_km, fuel_type, transmission, body_type, brand, model, location, is_sold, listed_at, thumbnail_url, plus total, page, limit and has_more.

q.description: Words the title must all contain (Cyrillic ok)

brand.description: Brand name, e.g. Volkswagen or VW

model.description: Model name, e.g. Golf; "Golf (All)" includes Golf Plus etc.

fuel_type.description: petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid, lpg or other; any case

transmission.description: manual, automatic or semi-automatic; any case

body_types.description: Any of these body types, e.g. suv, estate, sedan (= limousine)

status.description: active (unsold, default), sold or any; any case

sort.description: newest, price_asc or price_desc (any case); priceless listings last

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one listing in full: the search card fields plus description, engine_power_kw and engine_power_hp, engine_displacement_cc, color, registered_in_north_macedonia, up to 10 image_urls, source_url (the original ad), the dealership's or private seller's public contact, and market_comparison (price spread of similar active listings and this price versus their median; null with fewer than 3).

tools.name: find_similar_listings
tools.description: Find active listings similar to one listing, newest first. Tries in order and returns the first level that finds any, named in match_level: same_model_close (same model and fuel, ±2 years, ±€3,000, ±35,000 km), same_model (±4 years, ±€6,000, ±60,000 km), same_brand, same_dealer, any_active. The two same_model levels need a priced listing. Cards have the search_listings fields.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Car brands by name with their number of active (unsold) listings. By default only brands that have listings. The brand "Other" holds listings whose brand isn't in the catalogue.

include_empty.description: Also list entries without active listings (default false)

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: A brand's models with their number of active listings. Umbrella models (is_umbrella, named "... (All)", e.g. "Golf (All)", "Passat (alle) (All)") cover the whole family, so their count includes every variant. "Other" holds listings whose exact model is unknown. By default only models that have listings.

brand.description: Brand name; any case, Cyrillic or alias (VW, Mercedes)

include_empty.description: Also list entries without active listings (default false)

tools.name: get_search_options
tools.description: Valid values for the fixed-choice filters of search_listings: locations (towns), body types, fuel types, transmissions, sort orders and statuses. Locations and body types also match in Cyrillic and by common aliases (sedan = limousine, wagon or kombi = estate).

tools.name: list_dealers
tools.description: Dealerships whose listings Najdikola shows, with their number of active listings. Pass a name as the dealer filter of search_listings. By default only dealers that have listings.

include_empty.description: Also list entries without active listings (default false)

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Estimate a used car's market price in EUR from comparable active listings of the same model (an "(All)" model includes its variants). It starts at ±1 year with the same fuel, then widens to ±2, ±3 and ±5 years (the last two with any fuel) until at least 3 comparables are found; with a mileage it prefers listings within ±40,000 km. Returns the segment actually used, price stats (the median is the best single estimate), confidence (low under 5 comparables, medium 5-14, high 15+), sufficient_data, up to 3 example listing URLs and notes. Fuel type "other" is ignored.

brand.description: Brand name; any case, Cyrillic or alias (VW, Mercedes)

model.description: Model name from list_models; "Golf" also finds "Golf (All)"

fuel_type.description: petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid, lpg or other; any case
